name: VPN
author: Robin Mai
description: Toggle OpenVPN, WireGuard or GlobalProtect from the bar and see throughput, connection details and profiles in a popup.

barWidget.description: Toggle the tunnel, watch throughput and connection details, import and manage profiles. Supports OpenVPN, WireGuard and GlobalProtect.

schema.label: VPN type
schema.description: Which VPN this instance controls. WireGuard covers both wg-quick units and NetworkManager connections. GlobalProtect can be watched and disconnected; connecting hands off to a terminal because the login is interactive.

schema.label: Profile
schema.description: OpenVPN: the openvpn-client@<profile> instance. WireGuard: the interface or NetworkManager connection name. GlobalProtect: the portal server, or empty to open the GUI.

schema.label: Status interval (seconds)
schema.description: While idle. During a transition and while the popup is open it polls faster on its own.

schema.label: Throughput in the bar
schema.description: Shows the current rate next to the icon while connected. No effect on vertical bars.

schema.label: Highlight when connected
schema.description: Tints the icon with the accent colour while the tunnel is up instead of just showing it at full opacity.

schema.label: Only show when connected
schema.description: Hides the icon entirely while the tunnel is down.
